Definition: Jojarib, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Joiarib is named 5 times in the Bible, and the passages here are Ezra 8:16; Nehemiah 11:5; Nehemiah 11:10. In Ezra 8:16 we read, "Then sent I for Eliezer, for Ariel, for Shemaiah, and for Elnathan, and for Jarib, and for Elnathan, and for Nathan..." The same name belongs to more than one man, and Nehemiah 11:10 names another of them.
TheologicalSignificance: Joiarib is a name the Bible did not forget, and I believe God forgets no one. The Bible does not waste names, and neither does God.
RelatedPeople: Joiarib, Chief Man; Joiarib, Father of Jedaiah; Joiarib, Son of Zechariah
